title: Access to Finance shared drive - Budget 2027 folder
body:
Hi, I need read/write access to \\fs01\finance\Budget2027. I joined the FP&A team this week and I can't start consolidating the Q4 forecasts until I have access. Right now I get "Access denied" when I open the folder.

My manager is Gabriela Ríos, she can approve.

comments.author: Gabriela Ríos
comments.body: Approved. Tomás needs the same access as the rest of FP&A on Budget2027.
